entities.summary: Yutog Yontan Gonpo, also known as Yuthog Yontan Gonpo the Elder, is widely accepted to be a legend invented by the descendants of Yuthok Yontan Gonpo the Younger as a mythical 8th-century high lama and a physician of Tibet. Hagiographies claim he lived 125 years.
